memory: I record at 2000 fps; micro‑slips last ~10–120 ms. Dominant puncta (~0.32–0.33 mm) can contribute 25–31% of Σ|d|^1.1 and bias regression. Winsor 96% and Huber k≈1.3 are insufficient. Pilot bootstrap (1,200 resamples) suggested winsor ≈94–95% with Huber k≈1.05–1.2 reduces median coefficient variance; a per‑trial 0.34 mm cap further lowers variance at 2.0σ but introduces small threshold‑dependent bias at 3.0σ. Plan: full 5,000 stratified resamples across winsor 92–96%, k 0.9–1.3, testing cap and log‑transform arms.
